source_text: De Pharaone rege Aegypti retractemus — principes non corporeos. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let us also treat of Pharaoh king of Egypt — princes not bodily. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Likewise weigh [[Pharaoh king of Egypt >> Bible:Ezekiel 29:2-3]] among invisible rulers, not flesh alone. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
